name: Middle Tennessee Solar LLC
old_description: Founded in 2011 by solar innovator David Ding, Growatt was built with one mission: to make clean energy accessible to everyone. Backed by a team of global PV experts, Growatt designs high-performance solar solutions trusted by homeowners, businesses, and installers worldwide.
about:
Middle Tennessee Solar LLC operates from Clarksville, Tennessee. The company began in 2019 with a focus on simplifying solar power for homeowners and contractors across Middle Tennessee. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm functions as a solar equipment distributor, stocking photovoltaic panels, battery storage, inverters, charge controllers, and associated mounting hardware and cabling. It carries product lines from EG4 Electronics, AIMS Power, Schneider Electric, and Growatt, among others. The company reports more than 500 clients served, over 366 projects completed, and relationships with 85-plus business partners. No facility size or employee count is published.

Customers include DIY enthusiasts, homesteaders, residential contractors, and small commercial installers building off-grid, grid-tied, or hybrid solar systems. The supplier also works with businesses seeking component-level procurement without installer markups.

Middle Tennessee Solar emphasizes a curated product selection — only brands the team would use in their own homes — and avoids pre-bundled kits that inflate costs. It promotes direct access to technical support and fast local shipping from its Clarksville location as key differentiators.
